CLDR.description: Constraint Label Direction (CLDR). Keyed by element number; each entry sets the local constraint label direction via the DIR integer code.

DIR.description: Constraint label direction as a local-axis integer code: 0 = Local x (+), 1 = Local x (-), 2 = Local y (+), 3 = Local y (-), 4 = Local z (+), 5 = Local z (-).
